summary: Practise fair complaint triage, workplace investigations, and case tracking. Explore the five-day employee grievance management course.
lede: Complaint management training helps HR advisers, employee relations practitioners, and line managers assess workplace complaints and decide fair next steps. Participants practise triage, evidence documentation, structured interviewing, and assessing findings to identify proportionate resolution options. They also learn to track cases and report anonymized trends while protecting confidentiality and keeping human review in AI-assisted categorisation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who receive, investigate, advise on, or oversee employee complaints and grievance cases.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of workplace policies or employee relations processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Word and Excel for document and case-tracking exercises.
